u0434: ## What do one and two extensions cost?
u0435: One stage through SAFRWAY costs **2 500 000 IDR (≈ {{USD_2_5M}})**. The price is the same for D1 and D2.
u0436: Two stages cost **5 000 000 IDR (≈ {{USD_5M}})**. This is the sum of two extensions, not a price that includes the initial D1/D2 application. Each stage is paid separately as needed.
u0437: Calculate your overall trip costs using the visa already obtained and the actual number of extensions. [Initial D1 and D2 application prices](/bali/visas/d1-d2/) are listed separately.
u0438: ## When is an extension actually needed?
u0439: An extension is needed if you want to remain beyond your current permitted stay without leaving. If you depart before that date, an extension may not be necessary.
u0440: If you plan to return after leaving, separately check that the multiple-entry visa will be valid on your next entry date. An old extension does not replace a valid visa for the next trip.
u0441: ## If both the visa and permitted stay are expiring
u0442: These are not the same procedure. Extending your stay does not add another year to the visa. Future trips may require a new D1/D2.
u0443: Do not judge whether your stay is lawful using just one of the dates. Send both documents and your departure plans to the manager. SAFRWAY will review them together and suggest an appropriate route.
u0445: Contact your manager in advance, not on the last day. Time needed for document preparation and the application window allowed by the system are different things.
u0446: We do not promise one fixed preparation time or a guaranteed result date for every case. The manager will check the time remaining, the current procedure and possible office appointment dates. An urgent request does not mean automatic approval.
u0447: ## Online submission and the office visit
u0448: The published procedure includes online document submission and an in-person immigration office visit for a photo and interview. Submitting online therefore does not mean extending without a visit.
u0449: Special arrangements may apply to certain applicant groups. SAFRWAY will check the procedure at your place of residence and explain which actions you need to take.
u0450: ## What should you send for review?
u0451:
- Passport and D1/D2 visa.
- Most recent entry date and evidence of entry.
- Latest stay permit showing its expiry date.
- Any previous extensions within this entry period.
- Residential address and planned departure date.
- Sponsor details, if the visa was obtained with a sponsor.
u0452: If another agent handled the initial application, we do not promise an automatic sponsor change. We first check the documents and the available way to continue the case.
u0453: ## If your stay has already expired
u0454: Tell your manager the exact stay expiry date and which steps you have already taken. Simply sending a message or creating an application draft is not evidence that your status has been extended.
u0455: An overstay cannot be treated as an ordinary extension service. Do not conceal dates or upload altered documents. The next steps depend on your actual status.
u0456: ## What remains unchanged after an extension?
u0457: D1 remains a tourism/visitor visa and D2 a business visitor visa. An extension does not grant work KITAS status or permission for local employment.
u0458: Nor should you assume a direct D1/D2-to-ITAS conversion is a standard route. Discuss your [long-term visa strategy](/bali/visas/) with the manager in advance.
u0459: ### Do I have to pay for both extensions at once?
u0460: No. Each stage is applied for and paid separately when needed.
u0461: ### Will I lose remaining days if I apply early?
u0462: Under the published procedure, the next period starts after the previous one ends. Check the final dates on the issued permit.
u0463: ### Can I use the remaining extension days after leaving?
u0464: No. Departure ends the current stay. A new permitted entry on a valid D1/D2 starts a new period.
u0465: ### Can I obtain a third ordinary extension after 180 days?
u0466: In the standard sequence described here, one visit is limited to 180 days in total. Plan your next route in advance, taking departure and visa validity into account.
u0467: ### How much do two extensions cost?
u0468: **5 000 000 IDR (≈ {{USD_5M}})** — two stages at 2 500 000 IDR each. The initial visa is not included.
u0469: ### Can an entirely online extension be guaranteed?
u0470: No. The published procedure requires an in-person photo and interview at the immigration office.
u0471: ### What if I do not understand the dates on my documents?
u0472: Message a SAFRWAY manager with your visa, latest stay permit and entry date. We will check the dates and explain the next step.
u0473: ## Check your dates and extend D1/D2
u0474: **Message a SAFRWAY manager. We will review your documents, the stages already used and the time remaining, then recommend an appropriate extension procedure.**
u0476: D1/D2 documents: passport, bank statement and travel purpose | SAFRWAY
u0477: What to prepare for D1 or D2: passport, 3-month bank statement, proof of funds, photo, CV and itinerary. Additional guidance on purpose and sponsor documents.
u0478: D1/D2 documents: preparing a consistent application package
u0479: When preparing D1/D2, check your passport, 3-month bank statement, funds equivalent to at least 2 000 USD, photo, CV and itinerary. Additional documents depend on your purpose and the applicable filing procedure.
u0480:
- Passport: at least 6 months of validity.
- Bank history: the last 3 months.
- Funds: equivalent to at least 2 000 USD.
- Photo: recent and in colour.
- Travel purpose: consistent with the chosen D1 or D2 category.
- Sponsor: requirements are checked by category and nationality; published D1 rules contain nationality exceptions to the general sponsor-free procedure.
- SAFRWAY's additional 12-month statement requirement for E33G does not automatically apply to D1/D2.
u0481: # D1/D2 documents: preparing a consistent application package
u0482: D1 and D2 have similar basic documents but different travel purposes. Start by establishing why you are visiting, then prepare the appropriate package.
u0483: For tourism and regular personal trips, consider [D1](/bali/visas/d1/). For business meetings, negotiations, purchases and agreements, consider [D2](/bali/visas/d2/). The [category comparison](/bali/visas/d1-d2/) helps you choose without duplicating the same document checklist.
u0485:
| Document | What to check |
|---|---|
| Passport | Personal details, number and at least 6 months of validity |
| Bank statement | Last 3 months, account holder, bank, currency and balance |
| Proof of funds | Equivalent to at least 2 000 USD |
| Colour photo | Current appearance and compliance with the application requirements |
| CV | Truthful information consistent with the travel purpose |
| Itinerary | Dates, accommodation and actual plans |
| Purpose evidence | An appropriate letter, invitation or correspondence supporting your case |
| Sponsor documents | When a sponsor is required or used in the selected procedure |
u0486: This checklist is for preparation. The final requirements are checked against the category and current application form. Special supporting documents cannot be replaced by simply explaining the situation to a manager.
u0488: Provide a legible copy of the personal-data page without cropped fields or glare. Check the name, passport number, nationality and dates across all documents.
u0489: Do not carry an old passport number into a new application. If your passport has been replaced, tell the manager whether you already have a valid visa issued against the old document. This is a separate situation, not an ordinary first application.
u0491: Prepare a statement for the last 3 months that clearly identifies the account holder, bank, period, currency and balance. The basic funds reference is the equivalent of at least 2 000 USD.
u0492: Do not automatically apply E33G annual-income or additional 12-month bank-history requirements to D1/D2. They are different categories with different document packages.
u0493: If the statement is in another language or your funds are spread across several accounts, first send the original statements to the manager. Do not alter figures or assemble screenshots into a document that looks like an original bank statement.
u0495: Use a recent colour photo in which you are recognisable. Heavy retouching, blur or an image cropped from a passport may make the file unsuitable for the application form.
u0496: File size, format and limits are checked when preparing the upload. We do not promise one unchanging technical format for every version of the portal.
u0498: Your CV should truthfully describe your current activities. For a business D2, the explanation of the trip should be consistent with your role and the host organisation.
u0499: The itinerary sets out intended dates, accommodation and activities. It does not mean SAFRWAY recommends buying non-refundable tickets before visa issuance. Tell the manager in advance about tickets already purchased and urgent dates.
u0500: ## Evidence of the D1 travel purpose
u0501: For D1, provide evidence of your actual tourism, personal or permitted event-related purpose. The dedicated official listing provides for a letter, invitation or correspondence from an organisation, as well as a separate option supporting a family relationship with an Indonesian citizen.
u0502: The manager will identify which document applies to your case. Do not invent an invitation or family relationship merely to fill a form field.
u0503: ## Evidence of the D2 travel purpose
u0504: Explain whom you plan to meet and why: negotiations, purchases, goods inspection or signing agreements. Prepare any existing invitations, letters and business correspondence. The manager will check the requirements for your particular application.
u0505: Visiting a supplier or discussing a contract does not authorise employment at an Indonesian company. Tell us before choosing a visa if you plan paid local work, technical duties or ongoing management of production.
u0506: ## A sponsor and an inviting party are not the same thing
u0507: A sponsor, or penjamin, has a role in the immigration procedure, whereas an invitation supports the visit purpose or relationship with the host. One document does not always replace the other.
u0508: The dedicated official D1 listing describes a general procedure without a mandatory sponsor, with exceptions for certain nationalities. This does not mean that additional letters supporting the travel purpose are no longer required.
u0509: For D2, SAFRWAY checks sponsor requirements and the filing procedure separately. Do not automatically apply another category's rule or last year's instructions to your application.
u0510: ## Incomplete documents or an unusual case
u0511: Tell the manager what you have and what is missing. Different nationalities, a new passport, an unusual payment document or an application already started by another agent require a case-specific review.
u0512: A review does not guarantee approval. If the actual purpose does not fit D1/D2, SAFRWAY will suggest considering another category rather than changing the trip description to something fictitious.
u0514:
1. Passport.
2. Purpose, intended dates and frequency of travel.
3. Bank statement covering 3 months.
4. Photo and CV, if already available.
5. Itinerary and any existing evidence of the travel purpose.
6. Details of an existing visa, new passport or application already started, if applicable.
u0515: The manager will review the package, identify missing documents and confirm the price before filing. [D1/D2 application prices](/bali/visas/d1-d2/) and [extension of the current stay](/bali/visas/d1-d2/extension/) cover separate services.
u0516: ### Is a 12-month bank statement needed for D1/D2?
u0517: The basic checklist uses 3 months of history. SAFRWAY's additional E33G standard must not automatically be applied to D1/D2.
u0518: ### Is an employment agreement needed as for E33G?
u0519: Do not transfer the E33G package to D1/D2. Here, documents support the visit purpose and chosen category. The manager will clarify any additional evidence needed for your case.
u0520: ### Is a sponsor required for D1?
u0521: The official listing describes a general sponsor-free procedure, except for certain nationalities. Supporting documents for the travel purpose still need to be checked.
u0522: ### Can I assume that the same rule applies to D2?
u0523: No. SAFRWAY checks D2 requirements separately according to category, nationality and the current procedure.
u0524: ### Can I use an old passport with a valid visa?
u0525: Show both passports and the visa to the manager first. Do not use old details in a new application without checking.
u0526: ### Should I arrange a translation in advance?
u0527: Send the original files to the manager first. The translation language and format need to be determined from the particular documents.
u0528: ### Can I apply without all documents and send the rest later?
u0529: Do not rely on this as the standard procedure. First we check the complete package and application requirements.
u0531: **Message a SAFRWAY manager and tell us about your trip. We will review your documents, clarify the appropriate category and explain what to prepare for filing.**
